info.name: EShop - Week 1 API checks
info.description: Assignee B: validates login, search, product detail, cart and checkout against a locally seeded SUT.

exec: pm.test('Login returns 200 and a token', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().token).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
pm.test('Search returns matching product data', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; });
pm.test('Product detail returns product 1', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().id).to.eql(1); });
pm.test('Cart accepts an authenticated request', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Added to cart'); });
pm.test('Checkout creates an order', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().orderId).to.be.a('number'); });
